id: title:dmarchuk:notify on api survey responses without a completion flag

review.posthog_relevance: Adds SurveyType and partial response event tracking to survey payload construction, potentially distinguishing popover survey behavior and changing notification behavior based on partial responses.
review.reason: The change adds SurveyType and surveyEmitsPartialSentEvents to the survey payload construction. P1.F1.H2 and P1.F1.H3 distinguish popover surveys, while P1.F2.H4 replaces a boolean with a computed value for partial responses. This could support differentiated notification behavior and response tracking, but the exact implementation and its impact are not demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit and implementation are not demonstrated; the tier is assigned based on the observed code, not the outcome.
